_comment: Single authoritative source of truth for which routes are INDEXABLE (prerendered + sitemap-listed). Absence from this file is the default classification (retained-but-non-indexable or removed) — see COMMIT_3_INDEXABILITY_MATRIX.md for the full classification of every route family, including why routes are deliberately NOT listed here (63 service-location combinatorial routes, unsupported secondary-city routes, /faq and /faqs duplicate redirects). Consumed by scripts/prerender.js to derive both the prerender crawl list and sitemap.xml.

blog.note: Post slugs are discovered dynamically from sourceDir at build time, not hardcoded here.
